scripts.backend:dev: npm run shared:build && cd backend && npm run dev:raw
scripts.frontend:dev: npm run shared:build && cd frontend && npm run dev:raw
scripts.dev: npm run shared:build && concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev:raw" "cd frontend && npm run dev:raw"
scripts.build: npm run frontend:build && npm run backend:build
scripts.build:artifact: npm run build && npm run copy-frontend
scripts.server: npm install && npm run build:artifact && node backend/dist/server.js
scripts.electron:rebuild-native: npm run electron:prepare-binary && electron-builder install-app-deps && node scripts/prepare-node-pty.mjs
scripts.electron:dev: npm run shared:build && MICHI_RENDERER_PORT=$(node scripts/find-open-port.mjs ${MICHI_RENDERER_PORT:-3001}) && export MICHI_RENDERER_PORT && MICHI_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:$MICHI_RENDERER_PORT && export MICHI_RENDERER_URL && MICHI_DATA_DIR=${MICHI_DATA_DIR:-$HOME/.michi-dev} && export MICHI_DATA_DIR && MICHI_DEV_INSTANCE_ID=${MICHI_DEV_INSTANCE_ID:-$(basename "$PWD")} && export MICHI_DEV_INSTANCE_ID && MICHI_ELECTRON_USER_DATA_DIR=${MICHI_ELECTRON_USER_DATA_DIR:-$MICHI_DATA_DIR/electron-$MICHI_DEV_INSTANCE_ID} && export MICHI_ELECTRON_USER_DATA_DIR && echo '[electron:dev] renderer' $MICHI_RENDERER_URL 'instance' $MICHI_DEV_INSTANCE_ID && concurrently "cd backend && npm run dev:raw" "cd frontend && npm run dev:raw -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port $MICHI_RENDERER_PORT" "npm run electron:dev-wait"
scripts.electron:dev-wait: wait-on ${MICHI_RENDERER_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:3001} && npm run electron:build-main && npm run electron:rebuild-native && NODE_OPTIONS= ELECTRON_DEV=1 electron --remote-debugging-port=${ELECTRON_DEBUG_PORT:-9222} electron/dist/main.js
scripts.electron:build: VITE_API_URL=/api npm run frontend:build && npm run backend:build && npm run electron:build-main && npm run electron:rebuild-native && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.test:electron-shortcuts: npm run electron:build-main && node --test scripts/electron-pane-shortcut.test.mjs && NODE_OPTIONS= ./node_modules/.bin/electron scripts/electron-native-shortcut-smoke.cjs
scripts.test:e2e: npm run shared:build && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:ui: npm run shared:build && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts --ui
